title: Panasonic Nanoe Hair Dryer EH-NA0J-W
description_en: Panasonic's nanoe technology releases 1,000× more moisture than conventional ions, dramatically reducing frizz and split ends. The EH-NA0J also features Quick Dry mode and a scalp mode for hair growth support. A staple of Japanese hair salons.
description_ja: パナソニックのナノイー技術は通常イオンの1000倍の水分を放出し、うねり・枝毛を大幅に改善。スカルプモードで頭皮ケアも。日本のサロンで定番のヘアドライヤー。
